messages:
rachel (pm): Proposal for a 'community model certification' lane: allow low-touch community/contrib models into catalog after an automated security+licensing check, lightweight bench, and a 14-day customer-preview window. Aim: increase catalog velocity with clear guardrails.

tom (security): We need an automated SBOM check, license whitelist, and a runtime sandbox test (no network, limited syscalls). Fail fast on known-malicious signatures.

jules (legal): License whitelist: Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD ok. GPL-family require legal review. Also require a simple contributor attestation checkbox during submit.

marco (eng): Automation sketch: pipeline runs: 1) metadata lint, 2) SBOM + license scan, 3) smoke perf (20 prompts), 4) embedding-sim similarity vs baseline, 5) infra-sandbox test. If all pass, publish to 'community-preview' catalog for 14d.

nina (ops): Ops needs caps: community models default to 5% global quota, per-tenant concurrency cap, and auto-throttle if infra_util > 70%. Also mark these models as non-SLA (no uptime guarantees).

carla (support): Support needs clear copy: "community-preview: experimental, no SLA, opt-in only." Provide canned responses and an escalation path to security for any suspicious outputs.

rachel (pm): Metrics/gates proposed: p95 latency change < 25%, error_rate < 1% abs, semantic_sim_drop < 0.04, no license or SBOM violations. Rollback on any security/license fail or eval delta > 0.06.

marco (eng): Example YAML for pipeline snippet:
```yaml
community_cert_pipeline:
  metadata_check: true
  sbom_scan: true
  license_whitelist: [Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD]
  smoke_test_prompts: 20
  semantic_sim_threshold: 0.04
  preview_window_days: 14
  global_quota_pct: 5
  infra_throttle_pct: 70
```

tom (security): Also add a daily quick-scan during preview that checks for prompt-injection vectors on sampled requests (opt-out by tenant).

jules (legal): Add contributor attestation + a field for contact and CLA link if required. Keep export-control questions visible at submit time.

rachel (pm): Comms: add "community-preview" tag in Console and a short modal at publish time that explains preview risks. Offer a way for customers to opt-out of receiving traffic from preview models.

nina (ops): I'll create a monitoring dashboard and alerts for SBOM+security flags, infra pressure, and semantic drift. Also pre-create channel #community-cert-alerts.

carla (support): I'll draft FAQ and canned messages. We should auto-exempt pinned customers from preview traffic.

cert-bot: scheduled job created: `community-cert 5189990000 --policy pipeline_v1 --model redwood/community-lite-0.9` :gear:

rachel (pm): Decision items this sprint: approve license whitelist (legal), confirm infra caps (ops), finalize attestation language (legal/product), and QA the smoke-suite (eng). Aim to flip pilot switch in 10 days.

marco (eng): I'll land the lightweight smoke-suite today and post results.
tom (security): I'll add the SBOM integration and quick-scan hook.
jules (legal): I'll finalize whitelist & attestation copy by EOD Wednesday.

rachel (pm): Thanks all — tagging @marco @tom @jules @nina @carla. If no objections we'll start the pipeline on the pilot candidate next Wednesday. Closing thread unless issues.
